audit.report: Month-end close job batch_replayable_month_end_close (pid 116390) held an idle transaction open for 4.0 seconds and blocked 12 sessions, causing checkout timeouts. Checkout success fell from 53% over 15 seconds to 0% over 30 seconds (118/118 failed) against a 95% SLO, putting about $18,400 per minute at risk. Both guardians agreed to terminate the blocker because waiting its ~3,596 remaining seconds would cost about $1,102,773 and exceed the 60-second degradation tolerance. However, an active change (CHG-4410) requires consulting the finance-ops owner before interrupting inventory_month_end_close, which would take 95 minutes to replay. The guardians escalated to finance-ops instead of acting; no recovery action was executed and checkout remained degraded at the end of the trace.
